backports.description: Add an explicit opt-in control for Try Omarchy Touch ID sudo authentication under Setup > Security.
Install 1Password from its signed ARM64 release with VM-compatible launchers and Quick Access.
Add Vivaldi to Omarchy's browser workflows and install its signed official ARM64 RPM as a Pacman-owned package.
Expose Vivaldi in Install/Remove/Default Browser menus for the Try Omarchy ARM64 installer.
Restore the upstream hover-revealed notification dismiss control omitted from v4.0.2.
Hide and pause notification popups while the screensaver or lock surface obscures the session.
Clarify that Omarchy's 10 GiB update free-space check measures the guest VM disk, not the Mac host.
Recognize package-owned ARM kernel module metadata and explicitly distinguish matching, changed, and unknown kernel reboot states.
Clarify the first-login invitation for supported package updates and optional setup in the pinned Try Omarchy guest.
Refuse known aarch64-unavailable packages from omarchy-pkg-add with the shared message.
Refuse known aarch64-unavailable packages from omarchy-pkg-aur-add with the shared message.
Stop the Dropbox installer on aarch64 before tray setup, using the shared unavailable message.
Fail GeForce NOW install on aarch64 with the shared pacman/AUR unavailable message (vendor installer is x86_64-only).
Fail Battle.net Install on aarch64 before umu-launcher/Wine setup (installer-only; not a global wine denylist).
Fail Lutris Install on aarch64 before Wine/umu package pulls (installer-only; not a global wine denylist).
Add US International with dead keys, distinguish Brazilian ABNT2, and preselect Japanese on JIS Macs.
Build and install a verified ARM64 Ghostty package through the terminal menu.
Offer explicit live macOS time zone mirroring in owner setup and the timezone menu.
Show the read-only macOS power profile and preserve the Mac battery charge state while power estimates settle.
Pin shell QtQuick imports to 6.11 to avoid the Qt 6.12 Color singleton collision.
Install and launch Omarchy's Spotify web app on aarch64, where Spotify ships no native app.
